units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 4:1:2">Y. Kil. IV, beg. 29ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:19">Ab. IV, 19</cite>, a. fr. <he>שמואל הק׳</he> Samuel the junior; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:13:4">Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00796">preced.</cite>
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 2:8">Yeb. II, 8</cite> <he>הק׳</he> a younger brother.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37:7">Gen. R. s. 37</cite> <he>ומה אם הק׳ שהוא מקטין וכ׳</he> if an inferior person that is contented with a subordinate position (v. <cite ref="S00796">preced.</cite>) is thus rewarded, how much more a great man &c.
Gen. R. s. 93 קְטַנָּן של שבטים one of the youngest of the tribes; Yalk. ib. 152 (not קטנו); Yalk. Ps. 762; a. fr.—Esp. minor, a boy under thirteen, a girl under twelve years.

<cite ref="Gittin 65a:9">Gitt. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>שלש מדות בק׳ וכ׳</he> there are three legal stages of a minor: when he throws away a pebble &c., v. <cite ref="R00751"><he>צְרוֹר</he> II</cite>; <he>וכנגדן בק׳ מתקדשת וכ׳</he> and in the corresponding stage a girl may be betrothed subject to protest (<cite ref="M01077"><he>מִיאוּן</he></cite>). Ib. II, 6 <he>קבל הק׳ והגדיל</he> if he received a letter of divorce (as a carrier) while he was a minor, and reached majority before delivery.
<cite ref="Sotah 22a:12">Sot. 22ᵃ</cite> (among those who are a ruin to the world) <he>ק׳ שלא כלו לו וכ׳</he> a child whose months are not complete (a prematurely born child), expl.

<cite ref="Sotah 22a:12">ib.</cite> ‘a student who disregards his teacher’, or ‘a student who constitutes himself a teacher before regular ordination.’—Pl. <he>קְטַנִּים</he>; <cite ref="S00798"><he>קְטַנּוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 13:1">Tosef. Snh. XIII, 1</cite> <he>קטנים בני רשעי ארץ</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="S00801"><he>קְטַנֵּי</he></cite>) children of the wicked of the land that died in childhood; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 110b:12">Snh. 110ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:8:5">Y. Shebi. IV, end, 35ᶜ</cite> <he>ק׳ ישראל</he> children of Israelites (that died); <he>ק׳ גוים</he> of gentiles.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 2:3">Keth. II, 3</cite> <he>ק׳ היינו</he> we were minors (when we signed as witnesses).
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 7:9">Ib. VII, 9</cite> <he>מומין הק׳</he> minor physical blemishes.
Ib. 49ᵇ מק׳ חסידים of the youngest (last) of the pious men (v. next w.); a. fr.—Euphem. קְטַנִּים (sub. נקבים) the minor functions of the body, urinating.
